about_the_game:
Crosshair Core

Aim better. See clearer. Play sharper.
Crosshair Customizer is a lightweight tool built to help you find the perfect crosshair for your playstyle. Adjust, preview, and fine-tune your reticle in seconds. Whether you're grinding ranked or just want a cleaner look, your aim starts here.

Features

Full Customization: Change color, size, thickness, outline, and more to match your setup.

Real-Time Preview: See updates instantly so you can dial in the perfect look.

Designed for FPS Players: Built for focus, clarity, and competitive visibility.

High-Contrast Options: Make your crosshair stand out on any map or background.

Clean, Distraction-Free UI: Simple layout so you spend less time adjusting and more time playing.

Precision starts with the center of your screen. Lock in your crosshair. Lock in your aim. 🎯

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance may vary depending on project size and export resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD equivalent or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 4K/8K exports, AI-assisted features, and large multi-track projects.

short_description: Customize your crosshair, aim sharper, and fine-tune your setup for peak FPS performance.
